dialogue.htmlContent:
You tell Meraxis that the time has come for the two of you to set off and find Takahashi.

#IF(meraxis.isPregnant())

[meraxis.speech(Then what are we waiting for?!)] the chuuni [meraxis.race] excitedly asks. After leaping to her feet, she suddenly seems to lose her confidence, and she rubs her hand over her #IF(meraxis.isVisiblyPregnant()) visibly-swollen belly and mumbles, [meraxis.speech(I kind of feel like I should deal with this before going on an adventure...)] #ELSE flat tummy and mumbles, [meraxis.speech(I took a pregnancy test and... you got me pregnant, [pc.name]. I kind of feel like I should deal with this before going on an adventure...)] #ENDIF

You tell Meraxis that the Shinrin Highlands can wait; it's best if she gets some rest and waits until the two of you can deal with her pregnancy before setting out on what could end up being a dangerous journey.

[meraxis.speech(Wait?! No! Takahashi might be in trouble, and we've waited long enough,)] she declares, before saying, #IF(meraxis.getPregnantLitter().getTotalLitterCount()>1) [meraxis.speech(You stay here, [pc.name]. Mommy always has some Mother's Milk, and she can help me to give birth. Our kids will be safe in Lyssieth's palace and my sisters will give them everything they need to sort themselves out!)] #ELSE [meraxis.speech(You stay here, [pc.name]. Mommy always has some Mother's Milk, and she can help me to give birth. Our kid will be safe in Lyssieth's palace and my sisters will give them everything they need to sort themselves out!)] #ENDIF

Not giving you a moment in which to object, Meraxis suddenly teleports away. Shaking your head, you sit down on the sofa and wait for her to return...

#ELSE

[meraxis.speech(Then what are we waiting for?!)] the chuuni [meraxis.race] excitedly asks. Leaping to her feet, she loudly proclaims, [meraxis.speech(Fear not, Takahashi, for we are on our way to rescue you!)]

You ask Meraxis if she's sure that Takahashi will need rescuing. After all, maybe she's just forgotten to check in with her, and is simply living in the Shinrin Highlands, waiting for Meraxis to come and find her.

[meraxis.speech(Takahashi has never failed to contact me before,)] Meraxis replies, [meraxis.speech(I find it hard to believe that she's really in trouble, but I can't think of another reason why she'd have kept me in the dark for so long. Hopefully we'll find her at my old hideout, and if not, then we should at least be able to find some clue as to her current whereabouts there. Come on, my nemesis, let's go!)]

You're left to catch up as Meraxis energetically bounds over to the door and rushes outside. Following in her wake, you step outside and hurry to catch up as the cheerful chuuni [meraxis.race] turns to the right and skips down the road in a westward direction.

[meraxis.speech(I wish we could just teleport there, but the youko have cast spells to prevent teleportation spells from working in the Shinrin Highlands,)] she says as the two of you head towards the west gate, [meraxis.speech(That book you saw me reading earlier gave me some clues as to how their anti-teleportation spells work, so once we're at my hideout, I should be able to counteract them within a localised area. In other words, we'll be able to teleport back here after we've reclaimed my hideout.)]

Continuing down the road, the two of you are soon passing through the gate. You look over at the Amazon's camp as you [pc.walk] past it, but although you see many of the Amazons moving about between the tents, you don't spot Ursa or Aurokaris.

After about fifteen minutes since you set out from The Red Dragon, Elis is getting smaller behind you, and the mountains to the west are looming up ahead. Between you and the snow-capped peaks in the far distance, lies a rolling landscape of forest-covered hills. Pointing to those hills, Meraxis proclaims, [meraxis.speech(Those are the Shinrin Highlands. My hideout isn't really too far away, but it'll still take us a few hours to get there.)]

#ENDIF

It takes an hour for Meraxis to return. One moment you're waiting alone on the sofa, and the next, in a flash of purple light, the chuuni [meraxis.race] has appeared in front of you.

[meraxis.speech(Mommy sorted it all out!)] she happily exclaims as she pats her flat tummy. Despite having spent quite some time in this new world, you're still not completely used to how easily pregnancies can be dealt with, and for a moment you're stunned and not sure what to say. Taking this opportunity to point her finger at you and strike a heroic pose, Meraxis energetically shouts, [meraxis.speech(What are we waiting for?! Fear not, Takahashi, for we are on our way to rescue you!)]

Recovering from the shock of realising that Meraxis has just given birth, you ask her if she's feeling ok, and if she's sure that Takahashi will need rescuing. After all, maybe she's just forgotten to check in with her, and is simply living in the Shinrin Highlands, waiting for Meraxis to come and find her.

[meraxis.speech(I'm fine, don't worry about me! And as for Takahashi; she's never failed to contact me before,)] Meraxis replies, [meraxis.speech(I find it hard to believe that she's really in trouble, but I can't think of another reason why she'd have kept me in the dark for so long. Hopefully we'll find her at my old hideout, and if not, then we should at least be able to find some clue as to her current whereabouts there. Come on, my nemesis, let's go!)]

You're left to catch up as Meraxis energetically bounds over to the door and rushes outside. Following in her wake, you step outside and hurry to catch up as the cheerful chuuni [meraxis.race] turns to the right and skips down the road in a westward direction.

[meraxis.speech(I wish we could just teleport there, but the youko have cast spells to prevent teleportation spells from working in the Shinrin Highlands,)] she says as the two of you head towards the west gate, [meraxis.speech(That book you saw me reading earlier gave me some clues as to how their anti-teleportation spells work, so once we're at my hideout, I should be able to counteract them within a localised area. In other words, we'll be able to teleport back here after we've reclaimed my hideout.)]

Continuing down the road, the two of you are soon passing through the gate. You look over at the Amazon's camp as you [pc.walk] past it, but although you see many of the Amazons moving about between the tents, you don't spot Ursa or Aurokaris.

After about fifteen minutes since you set out from The Red Dragon, Elis is getting smaller behind you, and the mountains to the west are looming up ahead. Between you and the snow-capped peaks in the far distance, lies a rolling landscape of forest-covered hills. Pointing to those hills, Meraxis proclaims, [meraxis.speech(Those are the Shinrin Highlands. My hideout isn't really too far away, but it'll still take us a few hours to get there.)]

Continuing west, you make your way through the fields which lie to the west of Elis, before reaching a point where the elevation and nature of the surrounding flora noticeably changes. Instead of a flat, open landscape, you find yourselves travelling up and down undulating terrain, which is sometimes punctuated by long, flat valleys in which rice fields and the occasional Japanese-style farmhouse is located.

[meraxis.speech(It's best to give those buildings a wide berth,)] Meraxis warns when you encounter your first farm, [meraxis.speech(There's no telling if it's a benevolent or trickster youko who lives there. A follower of Kazuha would invite us in and take joy in letting us rest for a while in her home, but if they're a servant of Kayo, then we'd receive nothing but misfortune.)]

After a couple of hours spent trekking through the Shinrin Highlands, you ask Meraxis if #IF(pc.isAbleToFly()) it'd be quicker for her to jsut grow her wings so that the two of you could simply fly to her hideout. #ELSE she's planning on growing her wings and flying up to scout the way ahead. #ENDIF Shaking her head, she warns, [meraxis.speech(There's nothing inherently dangerous about flying over these lands, but for now I want to avoid being seen as much as possible. If my hideout has been taken over by a trickster youko, then I don't want her to have any warning that I'm coming.)]

After almost five hours have passed since you left Elis, Meraxis suddenly stops and declares, [meraxis.speech(We're almost there. My hideout is in the next valley, so we just need to get over this last hill.)]

At that moment, a feminine voice drifts to you on the breeze, [style.speechFeminine(Please heed my words, travellers. You must turn back.)]

Spinning around to face the direction which the voice came from, you call out and demand that the owner of the voice show herself. Doing as you ask, a beautiful young woman, with long, white hair and four similarly-coloured tails swishing behind her, steps out from behind a tree. On top of her head, she has a pair of large, white-furred fox ears, which droop in a rather submissive manner as she courteously bows to you and Meraxis and introduces herself, [style.speechFeminine(I am Akinaga, and these are my lands which you are travelling through.)]

[meraxis.speech(She must be a follower of Kazuha; a trickster youko would never have shown herself to us so readily,)] Meraxis whispers, before surprising you by returning the youko's bow in a gesture that's too polite for you to have expected to come from the chuuni [meraxis.race]. Addressing this stranger, she says, [meraxis.speech(I'm Merxis, and this is [pc.name]. My home is over that hill, and we're on our way to see if my friend, Takahashi, is there.)]

[style.speechFeminine(Yes, I recognise you from when you used to pass through my territory many years ago,)] Akinaga reveals, before repeating her warning, [style.speechFeminine(I do not wish to see you come to harm, so please, turn back. A seven-tailed youko by the name of Shiranui has claimed the place where once you dwelt, and she has laid a potent spell over the area which will trap anyone who enters it within a realm of illusions. I believe that your friend, Takahashi, has wandered into this trap.)]

[meraxis.speech(Those illusion spells don't scare me!)] Meraxis boasts, regaining her usual energetic manner of talking in the process. Continuing on, she declares, [meraxis.speech(All you need to do to break those spells is to destroy the arcane anchors within the realm of illusion. Takahashi should have known that as well... No matter, we're going to rescue her!)]

[style.speechFeminine(You are correct,)] the youko replies, before sighing and leaving you with these parting words, [style.speechFeminine(I see that you are committed to your path. Shiranui-sama is a servant of Kayo, and is both powerful and crafty. I believe that the anchors she uses take the form of fires which burn bright pink and cannot be extinguished with water, wind, or any other mundane means. If you do willingly venture into her realm in order to save your friend, look for objects which seem out of place beside these fires. By destroying those objects, the fires will extinguish and the spell will be broken. Good luck.)]

With that, a shimmer of light passes over Akinaga, and she turns into a mass of autumnal-coloured acer leaves, which blow away in a sudden, unnatural gust of wind.

[meraxis.speech(Well, that explains why Takahashi hasn't made contact with me,)] Meraxis tuts, before turning to you with a serious look on her face and saying, [meraxis.speech(A seven-tailed youko is incredibly powerful, but even for one of them, it will be hard to keep the illusion spell going if there are three of us trapped within it. While it might have been impossible for Takahashi to extinguish the fires, it should be relatively easy to do once the two of us get in there. We just need to remember what Akinaga said; break any unusual objects near the fires to extinguish them. The fires serve as anchors to keep the spell going, so without them, Shiranui's trap will fall apart and we'll be set free.)]

You tell Meraxis that you understand, to which she happily nods and loudly declares in her usual, energetic manner, [meraxis.speech(Let's go save Takahashi then!)]

The two of you continue on your way over the next hill, and from your elevated vantage point, you're able to get your first look at the place where Meraxis's hideout is located. Gazing down into the valley, all you can see is a swirling, impenetrable wall of mist.

[meraxis.speech(That's Shiranui's trap; once we enter that mist, there's no way out except via destroying the arcane anchors which keep the spell powered. These traps are favourites of the followers of Kayo, but it takes at least a six-tailed youko to properly set one up,)] Meraxis says, [meraxis.speech(A seven-tail like Shiranui should be able to support three anchors within her trap, so there'll be three fires to extinguish. It's honestly a stroke of luck that she likes using fires as her anchors; I've heard that some youko use blades of grass or small pebbles as theirs.)]

Committed to rescuing Takahashi, and with a clear plan of how to escape from within Shiranui's trap, the two of you travel down the side of the hill and enter the mist-wreathed valley. Behind the ghostly silhouettes of the trees which line the sides of the path you find yourself travelling down, a shadowy, feminine figure flits in and out of your peripheral vision.

[shiranui.speech(Two more rude trespassers caught in my net!)] an amused-sounding, feminine voice calls out from all around you. This morphs into a burst of sinister-sounding laughter, and then suddenly the shadowy figure can be seen peeking out at you from behind multiple trees all at once. Turning to face these shadowy threats, you and Meraxis stand back-to-back, ready for whatever will come your way.

[meraxis.speech(Stay focused. So long as we don't get split up we should be-)] Meraxis says from behind you, but her words are suddenly cut short. Spinning around, you see that the chuuni [meraxis.race] has vanished, and so too have all of the shadowy figures. A total silence, as thick and as heavy as the surrounding mists, completely envelops you, and although you remain ready for her to reappear, Shiranui doesn't show herself to you again.

Thankfully, the beaten path which winds its way between the vague silhouettes of trees remains relatively clear of mist, allowing you to navigate through this illusionary realm. Hoping that Meraxis is not in danger, you set off down the path and begin your search for the fires which you need to extinguish in order to escape from this illusionary realm...
